title: Japan Fude Parcels
description:
Japanese Farmland Parcel Polygons (Fude Polygons in Japanese) represent parcel information of farmland.
The polygons are manually digitized data derived from aerial imagery, such as satellite images. Since no
on-site verification or similar procedures have been conducted, the data may not necessarily match the actual
current conditions. Fude Polygons are created for the purpose of roughly indicating the locations of farmland.

This collection holds 6 editions (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/jp/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2026). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:6668). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/jp/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are mapped: an authority delineated them from imagery or survey, with no farmer's declaration behind them.

providers.name: Japanese Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF, 農林水産省)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: land_type_en
table:columns.description: 衛星画像の目視判読による田、畑の地目コード (source column `land_type`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: admin_local_code
table:columns.description: ポリゴンの重心点と重なる市区町村の総務省地方公共団体コード (source column `local_government_cd`, per the fiboa data survey)

table:columns.name: determination:datetime
table:columns.description: The last timestamp at which the field did exist and was observed. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Japan — latest edition (2026) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2026/jp-2026.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
